artifact.benchmark_scope: Scripted studio speech of the training speaker and human-labelled podcast fragments; owner live-dictation quality has not been independently verified

training.selection_note: v6 is the best measured reference; a later deployment-matched epoch-2 retrain did not significantly improve it and was not selected

app_matched_regression.decision: v6 remains selected by the tie rule; candidate not installed

limitations: studio and Podlodka are controlled regression exams, not owner live-dictation proof
existing FLEURS manifests contain duplicate IDs: 192 unique Russian and 164 unique English keys were evaluated
a separate epoch-2 candidate was not accepted as an improvement over v6; its metrics must not be attributed to v6
WER and term accuracy in this document use percentage points (14.04 means14.04%), unlike the legacy v1 fractions

legacy_v1.note: preserved as Legacy; its original evaluation remains in the v1.0.0 tag
